result:
I've implemented round 370 (PERF-11a) with no STOP. Typecheck, lint, the four covering test files and the three new size budgets all pass. I did not run the browser checks; those are C's next step.

**What changed (8 files, all within the task's grants):**
- B's dispatched sketch went in unchanged; I verified its sha first. `app/root.tsx` is byte-equal to B's copy.
- **Chat:** `ChatContext.tsx` now loads the signalr library only when a chat connects, not on every page.
- **Studio pages:** a new `RouteTransition` component renders `/studio*` without the fade-in. Store pages keep their fade.
- **Tests:** two new test files, RT1–RT4 and CL1–CL4.
- **Budgets:** the three JavaScript-size rows in `perf/budgets.resources.json` are now hard limits instead of record-only.
- **Docs:** new doc `237-perf-root-diet-studio.md` in Georgian. Its status line reads "Completed (C round 370 PASS)", which only becomes true if C passes the round.

**Checks I ran (logs in `tmp/studio-real-loop/a-round-370/`):**

| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| `npm run typecheck`, `npm run lint` | both pass; lint shows only warnings that were already there |
| Biome on the 6 changed app files | passes; the 3 warnings were already in `root.tsx` |
| The 4 covering test files | 23/23 pass, and the chat file also passes in shuffled order |
| Size check (`studio-lab-resources`), on its own server at port 5188 | all three budgets pass, with exactly B's sketch values (table below) |
| Frozen-file check | passes |
| B's claims script | only the two lines B predicted differ (status line count, doc 237 now exists) |

| Page | JavaScript size | Budget |
|---|---|---|
| studio-lab | 362,477 bytes | 372,000 |
| home | 250,526 bytes | 258,000 |
| studio-guard | 270,648 bytes | 278,000 |

**Code review:** the code-reviewer scored it 8/10 with only Low findings, so I made no further edits. I've passed these to B in the report:
- No unit test proves `root.tsx` actually uses `RouteTransition`; C's root diff and page-HTML checks cover that.
- One store-page test (RT2) relies on a router library version detail and could break on an upgrade.
- An older type cast at `ChatContext.tsx:64`, outside my grants, still breaks the "no type assertions" rule.
- An architecture proposal for B and root, not acted on: Studio pages still load framer-motion through `RouteTransition` and other shared components.

**Not done by me:**
- the full test suite, `npm run verify`, the mutation tests and all browser checks (left to C and the gate);
- a real chat connection, which can't be tested here because the backend isn't available in the cloud.

Everything is in `tmp/studio-real-loop/a-round-370.md`, which lists C's exact next checks.
